units.title: SG-3.2 · Fix the doubled story-panel class in the game layout
Act: Rename StoryPanel root class to story-content
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: UNIT-045 change is done: StoryPanel.tsx:12 root className changed from "story-panel" to "story-content", no other lines touched. Step 1 matched the code as written, so no adaptation was needed. Confirmed GameLayout.tsx:9 is the only element with class story-panel (plus drawer-open), and styles.css .story-panel mobile fixed/transform rules now apply once, to the aside. npm run typecheck in game/frontend does NOT pass: tsc reports 3 errors, all in tests/layout.test.tsx (missing node:fs / node:path types and 'process'). That file is committed at HEAD (f4c139f, Verify-owned) and I did not touch it, so the failure predates this change. No non-test type errors. Not fixed here: tests and test config are out of Act scope; needs a Verify/config fix (e.g. @types/node in devDependencies and tsconfig types) to make typecheck green. Baseline: active scan v1, tip 9cda5131c65b08541fc685d8a0898d39a0e9e9fa; case HEAD 193e470f24e6ed81f86d3ab172760704c7b24aa5. Working tree has one modified file, uncommitted.
